items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: I played a couple of jobs with Pierron's band also.

ctx.x: Celestan or Ridgely? No. Bebe Ridgely. That was the manager of the band.

Yeah. But Celestan was the leader, the trumpet player, he was the leader, but Bebe Ridgely was the manager of the band. He took care of all the business. Did they have a violin in those days? Well, they were just about dying out. Pierron was the only one that I know of, Lef and Robichaux. They were the only ones that I can remember that played in, but all the rest of the head died out by that time. Paul. Do you know of anyone else? I think all of them Paul.
